scope.description: Bounded Ge'ez Anaphora of the Holy Apostles core constituent of the Asmara Catholic missal (imprint year ፲፱፻፯ = 1914/15; Roman approbation 25 Feb 1913; Asmara imprimatur 12 Apr 1913; ULB Bonn Goussen 1665, PDF pp. 40, 44-45): title and opening Eucharistic dialogue plus opening Preface (ነአኵተከ) on PDF p. 40; Christological preface continuation, Sanctus, Post-Sanctus, Institution Narrative (bread and cup), Anamnesis, Epiclesis (preserving the distinctive Asmara 1914/15 formula በተመጥዎተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኅብስት፡ ወጽዋዕ...), unity prayer and concluding doxology/peace on PDF pp. 44-45 (printed pp. ፳፱-፴ / 29-30), terminating at the decorative bar immediately before the Prayer of Fraction (ጸሎተ፡ ፈትቶ) and Our Father on PDF p. 46. Excludes the intervening Alexandrian intercessions and Prayer of Blessing (PDF p. 40 col. 2 lower half through p. 41), blank verso p. 42, and full-page Crucifixion illustration p. 43.
omitted_book_divisions: Title page, frontispiece, Ge'ez permission, Latin approbation/imprimatur and Ordo Communis (PDF pp. 1-39)
Intervening Alexandrian intercessions (በዝየ፡ ይዝክር፡ ሙታነ) and Prayer of Blessing (ጸሎተ፡ ቡራኬ) on PDF p. 40 col. 2 lower half and p. 41
Blank verso PDF p. 42 and full-page Crucifixion illustration PDF p. 43
Prayer of Fraction (ጸሎተ፡ ፈትቶ), Our Father (አቡነ፡ ዘበሰማያት), Order of Communion, and Anaphoras 2-14 (PDF pp. 46-181)
Decorative red rules, headpieces, woodcut of Apostles on p. 40, printed Ge'ez page numerals (፳፱, ፴), catchword mark, and ink colour

sources.rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Asmara 1914/15 (Missale Aethiopicum): Anaphora of the Apostles core constituent, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (Ethiopian year 1907 (1914/15) Asmara imprint; approbation 25 Feb 1913, imprimatur 12 Apr 1913). Derived directly from tracked public-domain facsimile artifact.ethiopian-catholic-church.missale-aethiopicum-asmara.ethiopian-1907-asmara.bonn-scan-pdf-b126e66a without modern translation or editorial reconstruction. Third-party historical text is excluded from Triptych's CC BY 4.0 license.
sources.transformation: Direct reading from 220-dpi rendered PNG images (and column zooms) of Asmara 1914/15 PDF pp. 40, 44-45. UTF-8 NFC, LTR Ethiopic script (U+1200-U+137F), LF line endings. Preserves native Ge'ez fidel vowel orders, labiovelars (ኰ, ቍ, ኵ, ቍዓ, etc.), and Ethiopic numerals (፪, ፫, ፭, ፮). Standardizes Ethiopic punctuation as printed: wordspace '፡' (U+1361), full stop '።' (U+1362), comma '፣' (U+1363), preface/question stop '፧' (U+1367). Retains printed speaker cues (ይ፡ ካ። = priest, ይ፡ ሕ። = people, ይ፡ ዲ። = deacon, ካ፡ ን። = assistant priest), inline red gesture cues such as (አማሪ) ('pointing') and bracketed [ወእምድኅረ፡ ንስቲት], quotation marks around the consecration words (”...”), and printed crosses as '✠'. Line wraps within speakers/rubrics joined cleanly; each speaker turn or rubric block occupies one physical line. Excludes page numerals (፳፱, ፴), ornament and colour.

sources.rights_basis: The anonymous official Ge’ez book carries the Ethiopian imprint year 1907, corresponding to 1914/15, and earlier 1913 approval and imprimatur dates. It is public domain in the United States by publication date. Bonn ULB marks this exact title (https://digitale-sammlungen.ulb.uni-bonn.de/content/titleinfo/3222909) Public Domain Mark 1.0. Retain the unchanged 181-page provider PDF with Bonn attribution; do not treat the 1913 approval as a separate printing or assert identity with Keren 1890.
